description: Immaculately finished and beautifully presented professional house share, offering high-quality accommodation in a highly desirable and convenient location. This impressive property has been refurbished and furnished to an exceptionally high standard, creating a modern, stylish and comfortable home that is ideal for working professionals seeking quality accommodation. A spacious en-suite room is available to let, finished with attention to detail and furnished with high-quality furniture to provide a comfortable and welcoming living environment. The property offers a clean, modern and well-maintained setting, with attractive communal areas and a relaxed atmosphere, making it an excellent place to call home. All bills are included within the rent, including household utilities, helping to make your monthly outgoings simple and straightforward with no additional hassle. The house is maintained to a high standard throughout, ensuring a pleasant and professional living environment for all residents.
